title: AndroidControl-Curated: Revealing the True Potential of GUI Agents through Benchmark Purification
authors_zh: Ho Fai Leung, Xiaoyan Xi, Fei Zuo
paper_type_zh: Android GUI 基准净化、数据发布与模型报告
best_for_zh: 研究移动 GUI agent 轨迹数据、grounding verifier、benchmark purification 与训练评测泄漏的读者
one_line: AndroidControl-Curated releases five static Android step-data views and screenshot archives, couples box-aligned scoring with LLM-human task and label correction, and uses 2,400 selected samples for GRPO agent training.
AndroidControl-Curated 将 AndroidControl 净化为五种静态 step 数据视图，以 box 对齐评分和 LLM-人工任务/标签修订支撑评测与 Magma-R1 训练，但训练重叠、许可证和可回放环境仍未披露。
why: It demonstrates that the evaluation contract and label quality can move GUI-agent success rates by double digits, while its released records and scorer make those effects auditable enough to study—provided users preserve the unresolved licensing, replay, split, and checkpoint boundaries.
inclusion_reason: This work exposes a concrete Android state-action benchmark object and shows how point-versus-box scoring, alternative valid actions, and task/label correction change GUI-agent evaluation; it is therefore directly useful for both trajectory-data audit and benchmark-construction practice.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary record is arXiv:2510.18488, submitted on 21 October 2025; only v1 and a 10-page PDF without an appendix or supplement were available, and no formal conference or journal venue was confirmed. The official GitHub repository, Hugging Face dataset, and redirected Magma-R1 model repository are the artifact sources used by this Card.

AndroidControl evaluates a GUI agent against one annotated action and, for grounding, an exact target point. The paper argues that this can mark an action wrong even when it activates the intended UI element, and that ambiguous instructions, multiple valid next actions, or incorrect ground truth can further confound the score. AndroidControl-Curated therefore treats the benchmark definition and labels—not only the agent—as objects to purify (Paper §2.1, pp. 3–4; §3.4, pp. 6–8).

The released object is a static state-action step, not a verified replayable episode. Depending on the JSON view, a row contains an image path, high- or low-level instruction/task, serialized prior-action history, target action, point and/or bounding-box target, input text, and optional revised task/history, alternative candidate actions, reviewer result, or original-versus-corrected action. Five JSON views and screenshot archives are public; no pinned emulator, app-version manifest, reset protocol, or live terminal checker was verified (official dataset benchmark_resource/*.json).

This supports environment_agent_trajectory_data because it exposes Android observations, action history, and step supervision, while benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces captures the paper's central claim that scoring geometry and label correction materially alter measured success. It does not establish a full environment episode release or a general-purpose mobile-agent training corpus. The Card reaches bilingual L4 content depth through the paper and audited official artifacts, while split, 2.4K training IDs, licensing, replay, and checkpoint mapping remain explicitly unknown.

本卡的首要论文记录是 arXiv:2510.18488，提交于 2025 年 10 月 21 日；可获得的只有 v1 和一份不含 appendix 或 supplement 的 10 页 PDF，也未确认正式会议或期刊收录。Card 对 artifact 的核验来自官方 GitHub 仓库、Hugging Face 数据集及重定向后的 Magma-R1 模型仓库。

AndroidControl 用一个标注动作评测 GUI agent，并以精确目标点评测 grounding。论文指出，即使动作触发了预期 UI element，这种设置仍可能判错；含糊 instruction、多个有效下一步动作或错误 ground truth 还会进一步混淆分数。因此，AndroidControl-Curated 把 benchmark 定义和标签本身——而不只是 agent——作为需要净化的对象（论文 §2.1，pp. 3–4；§3.4，pp. 6–8）。

发布对象是静态 state-action step，而不是已验证可回放的完整 episode。根据 JSON 视图不同，一条记录包含 image path、高层或低层 instruction/task、序列化的先前动作 history、目标 action、point 和/或 bounding box 目标、input text，以及可选的修订 task/history、候选替代动作、reviewer 结果或修订前后 action。官方发布了五种 JSON 视图和 screenshot archives；未验证到固定 emulator、app 版本 manifest、reset protocol 或 live terminal checker（官方数据集 benchmark_resource/*.json）。

该工作对应 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为它公开 Android observation、action history 与 step-level 监督；其核心论点又说明评分几何和标签修订会实质改变 success，因此也对应 benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces。它没有建立完整环境 episode 发布，也不是通用移动 agent 训练语料。论文和已审计官方 artifact 支撑本卡达到双语 L4 内容深度，但 split、2.4K 训练 ID、license、replay 与 checkpoint mapping 仍明确为 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AndroidControl-Curated combines two forms of benchmark purification: intent-aligned grounding that accepts a predicted point inside the UI element's bounding box, and task/label correction for cases on which three named expert agents all fail (Paper §2.1.1–2.1.2, p. 3).

The correction pipeline uses Qwen3-VL-235B, InfiGUI-R1, and GUI-R1 as a consensus-failure screen. An undisclosed LLM reviewer then classifies the deficiency, proposes a task revision and/or ground-truth revision, and supplies a rationale; human experts verify correction proposals before accepted changes enter the curated benchmark (Paper Eq. 6–7 and Algorithm 1, pp. 3–5). The paper does not disclose the reviewer model/version, its prompt or decoding, the number of runs per expert, or a complete human-review rubric and agreement record.

The feedback contract has two distinct layers. In the paper, grounding accuracy uses box containment, while success rate is described as requiring all steps to be correct and the intended final screen to be reached (Paper §3.1, p. 5). In the released static scorer, Step_Success_Rate is action-type plus grounding correctness for click/long-press and type-only correctness for other actions; input text uses substring/token-F1 logic and improved tasks may accept any retained candidate action (src/eval/utils.py; src/eval/evaluate_actions_androidControl_vllm.py, lines 205–273). That scorer observes parsed actions and static labels, but not a live Android terminal state.

The closest reference is upstream AndroidControl, which supplies the human demonstration lineage and point-based evaluation. The specific change is to make evaluator geometry, alternative valid actions, and corrected task/ground-truth fields part of the auditable data object. Magma-R1 then uses 2,400 selected curated steps for GRPO post-training, but the selection manifest and train/evaluation separation are unknown (Paper abstract; §3.1, p. 5).

AndroidControl-Curated 组合了两种 benchmark purification：一是 intent-aligned grounding，只要预测点落入相应 UI element 的 bounding box 就判为正确；二是修订三个指定 expert agent 全部失败案例中的 task 或 label（论文 §2.1.1–2.1.2，p. 3）。

修订管线使用 Qwen3-VL-235B、InfiGUI-R1 和 GUI-R1 进行 consensus-failure 筛选。随后，一个未披露的 LLM reviewer 对缺陷分类，提出 task revision 和/或 ground-truth revision，并给出 rationale；human expert 在接受修订进入 curated benchmark 前核验 proposal（论文 Eq. 6–7 与 Algorithm 1，pp. 3–5）。论文没有披露 reviewer 的模型/版本、prompt 或 decoding，也没有披露每个 expert 的运行次数及完整人工 rubric 与一致性记录。

反馈契约分为两层。论文中，grounding accuracy 使用 box containment，而 success rate 被描述为所有 step 正确且到达预期 final screen（论文 §3.1，p. 5）。发布的静态 scorer 中，Step_Success_Rate 对 click/long-press 要求 action type 与 grounding 同时正确，对其他 action 只检查 type；input text 使用 substring/token-F1 逻辑，improved task 可以匹配任一保留 candidate action（src/eval/utils.py；src/eval/evaluate_actions_androidControl_vllm.py，lines 205–273）。该 scorer 能观察解析后的 action 和静态标签，却不能观察 live Android terminal state。

最接近的参照是上游 AndroidControl，它提供 human demonstration lineage 与 point-based evaluation。本文的具体变化，是把 evaluator geometry、alternative valid action 及修订后的 task/ground-truth 字段纳入可审计 data object。Magma-R1 随后使用 2,400 条选中 curated step 进行 GRPO post-training，但 selection manifest 与训练/评测隔离均为 unknown（论文 abstract；§3.1，p. 5）。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins from AndroidControl human demonstrations; the upstream official publication reports 15,283 demonstrations, 14,548 unique tasks, and 833 apps. The exact AndroidControl revision consumed by this release is not disclosed.

The purification pipeline is:

  1. Convert exact-point grounding into intent-aligned box scoring: a predicted point is accepted when it falls within the bounding box of the UI element containing the annotated ground-truth point (Paper §2.1.1, Eq. 4–5, p. 3).
  2. Run Qwen3-VL-235B, InfiGUI-R1, and GUI-R1 on tasks and send consensus failures to the correction stage (Paper §2.1.2, Eq. 6, p. 3). Run counts, prompts, and decoding settings are unknown.
  3. Ask an undisclosed LLM reviewer for a deficiency category, task revision, ground-truth revision, and rationale; have human experts verify proposed corrections before applying accepted changes (Paper Eq. 7, pp. 3–4; Algorithm 1, p. 5). Panel size, sampled fraction, agreement, and acceptance thresholds are unknown.
  4. Release high/low point and box views plus android_control_high_task-improved.json. The latter may retain revised_task, revised_memory, candidate_predictions, candidate_actions, candidate_review_result, org_gt_action, and gpt_corrected beside the static screenshot, history, and action target (official dataset JSON).

For evaluation, model text is parsed from the answer and action XML-style tags; action names are normalized, click/long-press predictions are scored by predicted-box-center containment or a point-distance threshold, input text is accepted by substring/token-F1 at 0.5, and improved tasks can match any retained candidate action. The evaluation script uses vLLM with temperature 0.0, top-p 0.001, repetition penalty 1.05, and 512 maximum tokens; these are evaluation settings, not established GRPO rollout settings (src/eval/utils.py; src/inference/vllm_inference_Qwen2_5_VL_7B_SFT_batch.py).

For Magma-R1 post-training, the authors select 2,400 curated samples, use GRPO with a PPO-style clipped ratio and within-group reward normalization, assign a continuous Gaussian grounding reward from predicted-box-center distance to the ground-truth point, and stratify action sampling to increase rare type/scroll actions (Paper §2.2, Eq. 1–3, p. 4; Algorithm 1, p. 5; §3.1, p. 5). Group size, Gaussian sigma, clip epsilon, optimizer, learning rate, epochs, target action proportions, random seeds, and the 2.4K IDs are unknown; no GRPO trainer/config was found in the official repository.

Reproduction must pin the five JSON hashes and screenshot archives, GitHub commit, dataset revision, scorer and prompt code, model revision, and exact checkpoint. It must also supply the Easy/Hard mapping, train/evaluation overlap audit, and live environment if terminal success is claimed. The README evaluation command/path and the released entry point do not constitute a complete Tables 1–2 reproduction workflow, and the current model repository mixes a paper-era 3B root configuration with later 4B material.

构造从 AndroidControl human demonstration 开始；上游官方 publication 报告 15,283 条 demonstration、14,548 个 unique task 和 833 个 app。当前发布使用的 AndroidControl 精确 revision 未披露。

Purification pipeline 如下：

  1. 把 exact-point grounding 改为 intent-aligned box scoring：预测点落在包含标注 ground-truth point 的 UI element bounding box 内即接受（论文 §2.1.1，Eq. 4–5，p. 3）。
  2. 在 task 上运行 Qwen3-VL-235B、InfiGUI-R1 与 GUI-R1，并把 consensus failure 送入修订阶段（论文 §2.1.2，Eq. 6，p. 3）。运行次数、prompt 和 decoding 设置均为 unknown。
  3. 让未披露的 LLM reviewer 输出 deficiency category、task revision、ground-truth revision 与 rationale；human expert 核验 proposal 后再应用接受的修订（论文 Eq. 7，pp. 3–4；Algorithm 1，p. 5）。panel size、抽样比例、agreement 与 acceptance threshold 均为 unknown。
  4. 发布 high/low point、box 视图及 android_control_high_task-improved.json。后者可以在静态 screenshot、history 与 action target 旁保留 revised_task、revised_memory、candidate_predictions、candidate_actions、candidate_review_result、org_gt_action 和 gpt_corrected（官方数据集 JSON）。

评测时，模型文本从 XML 风格的 answer 和 action tag 解析；代码会归一化 action name，对 click/long-press 使用 predicted-box-center containment 或 point-distance threshold，对 input text 以 0.5 的 substring/token-F1 条件判定，并允许 improved task 匹配任一保留 candidate action。评测脚本使用 vLLM，temperature 0.0、top-p 0.001、repetition penalty 1.05、maximum tokens 512；这些是评测设置，不能视为 GRPO rollout 设置（src/eval/utils.py；src/inference/vllm_inference_Qwen2_5_VL_7B_SFT_batch.py）。

Magma-R1 post-training 选择 2,400 条 curated sample，使用带 PPO-style clipped ratio 与组内 reward normalization 的 GRPO；grounding reward 是 predicted-box center 到 ground-truth point 距离的连续 Gaussian reward，并通过 action-stratified sampling 增加罕见 type/scroll action（论文 §2.2，Eq. 1–3，p. 4；Algorithm 1，p. 5；§3.1，p. 5）。group size、Gaussian sigma、clip epsilon、optimizer、learning rate、epoch、目标 action proportion、random seed 与 2.4K ID 均为 unknown；官方仓库中也未发现 GRPO trainer/config。

复现必须固定五个 JSON 的 hash 与 screenshot archive、GitHub commit、dataset revision、scorer 与 prompt code、model revision 和精确 checkpoint；如声称 terminal success，还必须补齐 Easy/Hard mapping、训练/评测 overlap audit 与 live environment。README 的评测命令/路径和发布的 entry point 不能构成完整 Tables 1–2 reproduction workflow；当前 model repository 还混合了论文时期的 3B root config 与较新的 4B material。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 2 reports the effect of the two purification stages on the Hard subset. Qwen3-VL-235B success rate rises from 61.2 on original AndroidControl to 71.7 on Curated-Box and 76.5 on the fully curated benchmark; Magma-R1 rises from 57.6 to 69.1 and 75.3 under the same sequence (Paper Table 2, p. 6). These deltas show that metric and label choices change the reported evaluation outcome; they do not by themselves prove that every corrected record is high quality.

Under the authors' full curated setting, Table 1 reports Hard type accuracy / grounding accuracy / success rate of 84.2 / 84.8 / 75.3 for Magma-R1, compared with 88.2 / 83.6 / 76.5 for Qwen3-VL-235B. On Easy, Magma-R1 success rate is 88.0 versus 87.2 for Infi-GUI-R1 (Paper Table 1, p. 6). These are author-reported results and were not independently reproduced for this Card.

The paper attributes more than 70% of inspected high-risk cases to three deficiencies: 24.13% unclear tasks, 8.12% multiple valid actions, and 37.63% wrong ground truth (Paper §3.4.1 and Figure 4, pp. 7–8). The sampling denominator, panel size, per-item decisions, and agreement statistics are not separately released, so these percentages characterize the reported audit rather than certify the full dataset.

The paper reports post-training a 3B Magma-R1 on 2,400 selected samples for 60 H20 GPU-hours, approximately USD 60 (abstract; §3.1, p. 5). The official release audit finds five JSON views: 8,435 high-box rows, 7,708 high-point rows, 8,377 low-box rows, 7,708 low-point rows, and 8,377 task-improved rows. Within the task-improved file, 527 rows have revised tasks, 573 rows retain non-empty candidate actions totaling 1,233 alternatives, and 86 rows retain original and GPT-corrected ground-truth actions (official HF dataset revision 62aeecdcafa4097d340c5a4389690a5f14e938ed; audited file hashes in the evidence ledger). Unequal view counts and the absent split manifest must be preserved as release facts, not silently normalized.

表 2 报告了两阶段 purification 对 Hard subset 的影响。Qwen3-VL-235B 的 success rate 从原始 AndroidControl 的 61.2，提高到 Curated-Box 的 71.7，再到完整 curated benchmark 的 76.5；Magma-R1 在同一序列中从 57.6 提高到 69.1 和 75.3（论文 Table 2，p. 6）。这些差值说明 metric 和 label 选择会改变报告的评测结果，但不能单独证明每条修订记录都具有高质量。

在作者的完整 curated setting 下，表 1 报告 Magma-R1 在 Hard 上的 type accuracy / grounding accuracy / success rate 为 84.2 / 84.8 / 75.3；Qwen3-VL-235B 为 88.2 / 83.6 / 76.5。Easy 上，Magma-R1 的 success rate 为 88.0，Infi-GUI-R1 为 87.2（论文 Table 1，p. 6）。这些均为作者报告结果，本卡未进行独立复现。

论文把受检 high-risk case 中超过 70% 归因于三类缺陷：unclear task 24.13%、multiple valid action 8.12%、wrong ground truth 37.63%（论文 §3.4.1 与 Figure 4，pp. 7–8）。抽样 denominator、panel size、逐条 decision 与 agreement statistics 未单独发布，因此这些比例只刻画论文报告的 audit，不能认证完整数据集。

论文报告使用 2,400 条选中 sample 对 3B Magma-R1 post-train，消耗 60 H20 GPU-hours，约 60 美元（abstract；§3.1，p. 5）。官方 release audit 得到五种 JSON 视图：high-box 8,435 条、high-point 7,708 条、low-box 8,377 条、low-point 7,708 条、task-improved 8,377 条。在 task-improved 文件中，527 条包含 revised task，573 条保留非空 candidate action、合计 1,233 个 alternative，86 条保留原始与 GPT-corrected ground-truth action（官方 HF dataset revision 62aeecdcafa4097d340c5a4389690a5f14e938ed；文件 hash 见 evidence ledger）。各视图记录数不相等且缺少 split manifest，这些发布事实必须保留，不能静默归一化。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is AndroidControl: human mobile-UI demonstrations with point targets and a benchmark that can judge one annotated action as the sole valid choice. AndroidControl-Curated does not introduce the upstream demonstrations, the Android tasks, the named expert agents, GRPO, or GUI-agent grounding as such.

The first concrete change is the feedback interface: exact-point matching becomes UI-element box containment, so the evaluator is closer to interaction intent than pixel identity (Paper §2.1.1, p. 3). The second is a correction data object: consensus failures trigger LLM-proposed deficiency labels, revised tasks or ground truth, rationales, and human verification; released rows may preserve revised histories, alternative valid actions, review results, and original-versus-corrected targets (Paper §2.1.2, pp. 3–4; official android_control_high_task-improved.json).

The third change is a training use tied to the purified surface. Magma-R1 post-training uses 2,400 selected curated steps with a dense Gaussian grounding reward and action-balanced GRPO batches rather than relying only on sparse terminal success (Paper §2.2, pp. 4–5). This is a direction signal because benchmark purification, reward geometry, and sampling policy are treated as coupled data-engineering choices. The Table 2 deltas are evidence that those choices affect reported scores, not a record-level quality certificate.

The work is primarily an integration of evaluation redesign, label repair, a public static release, and a small post-training recipe. Before reuse, compare paper equations with the actual scorer, recover the 2.4K selection and split manifest, pin the 3B checkpoint used for Tables 1–2, inspect all rejected and corrected cases, and resolve code/data/screenshot licensing and live replay. Without those checks, the release is most defensible as an evaluation and audit reference rather than unrestricted training data.

既有工作基线是 AndroidControl：human mobile-UI demonstration 带 point target，benchmark 可能把单个标注 action 当作唯一有效选择。AndroidControl-Curated 没有提出这些上游 demonstration、Android task、三种指定 expert agent、GRPO 或 GUI-agent grounding 本身。

第一项具体变化是 feedback interface：exact-point matching 改为 UI-element box containment，使 evaluator 更接近 interaction intent，而非 pixel identity（论文 §2.1.1，p. 3）。第二项是 correction data object：consensus failure 触发 LLM proposal，其中包含 deficiency label、修订 task 或 ground truth、rationale 与 human verification；发布记录可以保留 revised history、alternative valid action、review result 及修订前后的 target（论文 §2.1.2，pp. 3–4；官方 android_control_high_task-improved.json）。

第三项变化是与 purified surface 绑定的训练用法。Magma-R1 post-training 使用 2,400 条选中 curated step，以 dense Gaussian grounding reward 和 action-balanced GRPO batch 替代只依赖 sparse terminal success（论文 §2.2，pp. 4–5）。这形成一个方向信号：benchmark purification、reward geometry 与 sampling policy 被视作耦合的数据工程选择。Table 2 的差值说明这些选择影响报告分数，而不是逐记录质量证书。

该工作主要整合 evaluation redesign、label repair、公开静态 release 与小规模 post-training recipe。复用前应对照论文公式与实际 scorer，找回 2.4K selection/split manifest，固定 Tables 1–2 所用 3B checkpoint，检查所有被拒绝和修订 case，并解决 code/data/screenshot license 与 live replay。完成这些检查前，最稳妥的定位是 evaluation 与 audit reference，而不是不受限制的训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The paper's success rate is defined through all-step correctness and the intended final screen, but the released evaluator computes static step success. A parsed action can satisfy the scorer without demonstrating that an Android episode reaches the terminal state; conversely, a valid live interaction outside the retained alternatives can be scored false.
  • Human/LLM correction is underspecified. The reviewer identity, prompt, decoding, expert-run count, panel size, sampled fraction, rubric, agreement, and correction threshold are unknown, while Algorithm 1 and the prose do not make the verification scope fully consistent (Paper §2.1.2 and Algorithm 1, pp. 3–5).
  • The 2,400 Magma-R1 training samples come from AndroidControl-Curated, which is also the evaluation surface. Exact IDs, selection rule, Easy/Hard mapping, train/test separation, and decontamination are unknown; training/evaluation overlap therefore remains a material leakage risk.
  • The release is static. No emulator image, Android/app-version manifest, account state, reset protocol, live environment runner, or terminal-state checker was verified, so screenshot/action records do not establish replayable episodes and may drift as apps change.
  • Artifact identity has drifted. The paper and root model config concern a 3B/Qwen2.5-VL model, while the current redirect is named Magma-R1-4B-AndroidControl and contains later Qwen3-VL-4B material. Table 1 attribution requires an immutable checkpoint mapping.
  • Dataset and code licenses are unknown because no repository LICENSE or dataset-card license was verified. The model card's MIT declaration does not grant rights to curated JSON, screenshots, upstream AndroidControl material, or third-party app content. Privacy/consent and record-level redaction are also undisclosed despite contact-like strings in released records.
  • Point, box, and task-improved files have unequal row counts without a conversion or split manifest. The official evaluation entry point covers only the task-improved map slice and does not reproduce all reported tables; failed rollouts, rejected proposals, and complete human decisions are not released.

• 论文把 success rate 定义为所有 step 正确且到达预期 final screen，但发布 evaluator 计算静态 step success。解析后的 action 可以满足 scorer，却未证明 Android episode 到达 terminal state；反之，未列入 retained alternative 的有效 live interaction 也可能被判错。
  • Human/LLM correction 披露不足。reviewer identity、prompt、decoding、expert 运行次数、panel size、抽样比例、rubric、agreement 与 correction threshold 均为 unknown；Algorithm 1 与正文也没有使 verification scope 完全一致（论文 §2.1.2 与 Algorithm 1，pp. 3–5）。
  • Magma-R1 的 2,400 条训练 sample 来自同一个 AndroidControl-Curated evaluation surface。精确 ID、selection rule、Easy/Hard mapping、train/test separation 与 decontamination 均为 unknown，因此训练/评测 overlap 是实质 leakage risk。
  • 发布是静态的。未验证 emulator image、Android/app version manifest、account state、reset protocol、live environment runner 或 terminal-state checker，因此 screenshot/action record 不能建立 replayable episode，也可能随 app 变化而 drift。
  • Artifact identity 已发生 drift。论文和 root model config 对应 3B/Qwen2.5-VL，而当前重定向仓库名为 Magma-R1-4B-AndroidControl，并包含较新的 Qwen3-VL-4B material。Table 1 的归因需要 immutable checkpoint mapping。
  • Dataset 与 code license 为 unknown，因为没有验证到 repository LICENSE 或 dataset-card license。model card 的 MIT 声明不授予 curated JSON、screenshot、上游 AndroidControl material 或第三方 app content 的权利。发布记录含 contact-like string，但 privacy/consent 与逐记录 redaction 也未披露。
  • Point、box 与 task-improved 文件记录数不等且没有 conversion/split manifest。官方 evaluation entry point 只覆盖 task-improved map slice，不能复现所有报告表格；failed rollout、rejected proposal 与完整 human decision 也未发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces, this Card supplies a concrete audit recipe: compare point, Curated-Box, and corrected-label scoring; log action parser outcomes separately from grounding outcomes; and report whether success is a static step predicate or a live terminal condition. Table 2 offers a useful controlled comparison, but benchmark deltas should not be interpreted as automatic proof of data quality.

For environment_agent_trajectory_data, the reusable unit is the static step record: screenshot, instruction/task, prior-action history, action target, geometry/text target, correction fields, alternative valid actions, and provenance. Builders can use the five released views to study GUI grounding, action normalization, ambiguity, label repair, alternative-action recall, and scorer false positives/negatives. They should not call the object a replayable full episode without adding a pinned Android environment, state reset, app versions, observation/action log, and terminal predicate.

The purification sequence can be tested as a data-construction baseline: consensus-failure mining, deficiency classification, proposed task/label revision, human verification, and retained correction provenance. The Magma-R1 recipe can motivate an agent-training ablation over dense distance reward and action-balanced sampling, but reconstruction requires the 2.4K IDs, GRPO configuration, train/evaluation separation, and exact 3B checkpoint.

Reuse class: suitable for evaluation and audit reference with pinned files and scorer; training reuse is blocked pending license clarification, overlap/split disclosure, correction provenance, and checkpoint mapping. It is not currently safe to claim unrestricted training reuse or live-environment reproducibility.

对 benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces 而言，本卡提供一套具体 audit recipe：比较 point、Curated-Box 与 corrected-label scoring，分别记录 action parser 和 grounding 的结果，并说明 success 指静态 step predicate 还是 live terminal condition。Table 2 可作为受控比较，但 benchmark delta 不能自动解释为 data quality 证据。

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，可复用单元是静态 step record：screenshot、instruction/task、先前 action history、action target、geometry/text target、correction field、alternative valid action 与 provenance。研究者可以用五种发布视图分析 GUI grounding、action normalization、ambiguity、label repair、alternative-action recall 及 scorer false positive/negative。若未补充固定 Android environment、state reset、app version、observation/action log 和 terminal predicate，就不应把它称为 replayable full episode。

Purification sequence 可作为数据构造 baseline：consensus-failure mining、deficiency classification、task/label revision proposal、human verification 与 correction provenance 保留。Magma-R1 recipe 可用于 dense distance reward 和 action-balanced sampling 的 agent-training ablation，但重建需要 2.4K ID、GRPO config、训练/评测隔离及精确 3B checkpoint。

复用等级：固定文件与 scorer 后，可用于 evaluation 与 audit reference；在 license clarification、overlap/split disclosure、correction provenance 与 checkpoint mapping 完成前，training reuse 仍受阻。当前不宜声称可不受限制地训练复用或具备 live-environment reproducibility。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Paper §2.1 and Algorithm 1 first: purification is box-aligned scoring followed by consensus-failure mining, LLM correction proposals, and human verification—not simply a renamed AndroidControl split.
  • Keep the paper's terminal success rate separate from the released static Step_Success_Rate; inspect src/eval/utils.py and src/eval/evaluate_actions_androidControl_vllm.py before reproducing scores.
  • Table 2's Hard SR changes—61.2→71.7→76.5 for Qwen3-VL-235B and 57.6→69.1→75.3 for Magma-R1—show measurement sensitivity, not record-level certification.
  • The 2,400 samples used for Magma-R1 GRPO have no released ID/split manifest, so overlap with the evaluation surface is unknown.
  • Pin the dataset revision, scorer, and exact 3B checkpoint; do not substitute the later 4B material in the redirected model repository without reporting the change.
  • Treat license, privacy, live replay, human-review protocol, and rejected-candidate retention as unresolved reuse gates.

• 优先阅读论文 §2.1 与 Algorithm 1：purification 是 box-aligned scoring，再加 consensus-failure mining、LLM correction proposal 和 human verification，而不是简单重命名 AndroidControl split。
  • 必须区分论文的 terminal success rate 与发布的静态 Step_Success_Rate；复现分数前先检查 src/eval/utils.py 和 src/eval/evaluate_actions_androidControl_vllm.py。
  • Table 2 的 Hard SR 变化——Qwen3-VL-235B 为 61.2→71.7→76.5，Magma-R1 为 57.6→69.1→75.3——说明 measurement sensitivity，不是逐记录认证。
  • Magma-R1 GRPO 使用的 2,400 条 sample 没有发布 ID/split manifest，因此它与 evaluation surface 的 overlap 为 unknown。
  • 应固定 dataset revision、scorer 与精确 3B checkpoint；替换为重定向 model repository 中较新的 4B material 时必须明确报告变化。
  • License、privacy、live replay、human-review protocol 与 rejected-candidate retention 都是尚未解决的复用门槛。

The paper's point-in-element formula and the code's predicted-box-center or normalized-distance checks are related but not identical scoring contracts.

No emulator image, app-version manifest, reset script, or live replay protocol was verified; the release is a static benchmark rather than a pinned executable environment.
